priority: push four proven core-loop formats into free external comparison traffic before producing more concepts

games.title: Odd One Out
games.short_description: Spot the one different symbol before time runs out as the visual grid gets harder.
games.description: Odd One Out is a short visual-search challenge built for fast retries. Find the one symbol that differs from the rest before the timer expires, then keep going as the board becomes harder. The compact loop is designed for score depth, replay and challenge sharing.

games.title: Reaction Rush
games.short_description: Measure five reaction taps and chase a lower average response time.
games.description: Reaction Rush is a minimal reaction-time challenge. Complete five reaction taps, compare the average result and immediately retry to improve it. The mechanic is easy to understand, highly repeatable and naturally suited to score comparison and friend challenges.

games.title: Sequence Snap
games.short_description: Complete the visual sequence, protect the streak and keep solving as patterns progress.
games.description: Sequence Snap is a compact pattern-recognition game. Read each visual sequence, choose the missing continuation and protect your streak as rounds progress. It gives the portfolio a fast cognition loop that can be compared directly on replay, accuracy and sharing.

games.title: Perfect Tap
games.short_description: Tap inside the timing window, build a streak and recover instantly after a miss.
games.description: Perfect Tap is a one-input timing game built around precision and repeat attempts. Tap when the moving timing cue reaches the target window, build a streak and chase cleaner runs. Its simple control scheme makes it suitable for mobile play, score comparison and rapid portal testing.
